name: control: ordinary overrides preserve unrelated nested defaults
missing layers and undefined properties inherit; undefined-only properties are omitted
delivery.enabled=false overrides true without removing recipients
limits.maxRows=0 and limits.timeoutMs=0 survive both precedence levels
display.title empty string is an explicit title
display.title null clears the title instead of inheriting
null at five inheritance paths falls through to workspace, including false and zero
null inheritance skips multiple layers and omits values absent everywhere
empty arrays replace recipients and columns completely
nonempty arrays replace rather than merge by position
additional nested fields preserve false, zero, empty string and explicit null
resolution itself never mutates any input layer
result edits cannot mutate source objects, arrays, or objects within arrays
